search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail *Policy* 
| json "eventSource", "eventName", "errorCode" nodrop 
| where eventName in ("SetDefaultPolicyVersion" , "CreatePolicy", "CreatePolicyVersion") and isBlank(errorCode) and eventSource="iam.amazonaws.com" 
| parse regex "[vV]ersionId\"\s*:\s*\"(?<version>[^\"]+)\"" 
| parse regex "\"(?<arn>arn:[^\"]+)\"" multi 
| parse regex field=arn ".*?:.*?:.*?:.*?:.*?:(?<resource>[^:]+$)" multi 
| where resource matches "policy*" 
| concat(arn, version) as policyId 
| count_distinct(policyId) as count 
| "IAM_CreateUpdatePolicy_CountEventResources" as benchmarkname 
| "EventResourceCount" as type 
| fillmissing values("IAM_CreateUpdatePolicy_CountEventResources") in benchmarkname, values("EventResourceCount") in type 
| toInt(count) as count
